messages:
Mina: Quick syncwe need a tiny relnotes entry for the upcoming docs push about the embed API change. Goal: one short bullet + migration link + callouts for known regressions.

Arjun: I can draft the bullet. Thinking: 'Embed streaming endpoints deprecated; use embeddings.v2 or non-streaming endpoints. See migration guide for examples.' Short and clear?

Mina: Good. Keep it consumer-facing (no internal flags). Also add a note: 'If you use streaming clients older than 0.7, you may see truncated payloads.'

Theo: I'll update the migration guide with compact python/js examples. Want to keep examples <=6 lines each. For python: 
```
from redwood import Embeddings
cli = Embeddings()
resp = cli.create(input=["one","two"], model="embed-v2")
```
And a one-liner for normalizing text: input = [s.strip().lower() for s in texts]

Mina: Add a tiny cache key suggestion too: `cache_key = sha256(json.dumps(input)).hexdigest()` and mention idempotency on retries.

Theo: Will add that. Also found a dead anchor in the migration guide linking to /docs/streams#faq. I'll change to /docs/streams-migration#faq.

Arjun: For the relnotes bullet, can we surface the severity: 'No app-breaking changes for most users; streaming-specific clients might need update.' Keep it calm.

Sara (PM): Please include a one-line 'who should care' on the relnotes: teams using streaming embeddings or SDKs <0.7.0. Also ask SDK teams to publish patch notes.

SDK-Bot: Noted. Opened PR 5021 (theo) for docs/migrations/embeds-v2.md with python/js snippets and cache paragraph.

Mina: Thanks. Two small asks: 1) ensure examples use the new client import style, 2) include a migration checklist at the top (3 bullets).

Theo: Done in PR. Migration checklist: update client >=0.7.0, switch to embed-v2 model, add input normalization.

QA-bot: QA will verify example outputs and provide screenshots for the console rollout card tomorrow morning.

Arjun: I've written the relnotes draft: 
- 'Streaming embeddings deprecated: migrate to embeddings.v2 or use non-streaming flows. (See migration guide)'
- Known issue: 'Some older streaming clients may receive truncated responses (400). Update SDKs to >=0.7.0.'

Mina: Post PR links here when ready. We'll merge docs PRs, then I'll paste the final bullets into the release notes doc and send to comms for the release email.

Theo: PR 5021 opened: https://git.redwood/inference/pull/5021

Mina: Small copy note: prefer 'streaming embeddings' phrasing across docs. Also avoid the term 'deprecated' in the migration title; keep it in the bullet only.

Arjun: changed wording in the relnotes draft per Mina.

SDK-Bot: SDK PR 3104 created to bump client >=0.7.0 and add changelog entry.

Mina: Great. Target: merge by EOD tomorrow. If QA gives green screenshots, we'll include the rollout card in the relnotes.

Sara (PM): I'll coordinate the comms thread once the relnotes are final. Thanks team.

Theo: Thx all :rocket:
